I saved the draft to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his direct message.

- **The draft:** It's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), with the subject "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the proposed 2027 rate of $2,356 per seat and says Anselm cleared sharing it.
- **Not sent:** It's still a draft, so Anselm can check it and send it himself.
- **Why no extra approval was needed:** Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway's sign-off for outside mail didn't apply. The per-seat rate is a finance figure, but Anselm can approve sharing those as CFO, and his message gave that approval.
- **Where the rate came from:** I used the $2,356 figure exactly as Anselm gave it (he said it came from Dana). I didn't check it against any channels or files.
